data.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 2:3 Pinterest editorial food photograph using the exact PELEG DESIGN Gratiator references: one ordinary-scale flat Roman-sword-shaped food grater with pointed perforated stainless-steel blade, dark navy crossguard, tapered grip, and open circular pommel. Rest it naturally across a handsome Caesar salad or beside the bowl with Parmesan shavings on pale stone, restrained cream/green/navy styling, and calm upper-quarter negative space for later typography. No hands, packaging, text, logo, CTA, duplicate, sharpened edge, violence, fantasy props, fake features, or malformed food.
notes: The result was inspected at full useful resolution and preserves a single recognizable Gratiator at plausible scale across a real Caesar salad.
The uncluttered pale-stone upper field supports restrained Arm B typography without covering the product.
